maps.heading: Maps
maps.paintHelp: Click or drag to paint with the selected terrain. Use arrow keys to move between tiles and Enter or Space to paint. Stripes mark blocked terrain; ● marks a player spawn. Coordinates start at 1.
maps.placeHelp: To use this map, add a map-view component to a scene and select this map there.
maps.references: Used in scenes: {scenes}. Keep their viewports within the map and their player spawns on walkable terrain.
maps.deleteConfirm: Delete map {id}? Maps used by scenes cannot be deleted. You can undo a successful deletion.
maps.cropConfirm: Reduce the map size? Tiles outside the new dimensions will be removed from this draft.
maps.fillConfirm: Replace every tile in this draft with {terrain}?
maps.saveFirst: Save or discard the map draft before switching maps or panels.
maps.invalidSize: Use positive whole dimensions with at most 65,536 tiles.
maps.invalidTerrain: Use a terrain ID with letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Reserved names are not allowed.
maps.lastTerrain: Keep at least one terrain type.
maps.replacementRequired: Choose another terrain type to replace tiles using the removed terrain.
maps.minimapHelp: Click to center the view. The outline marks the visible area. Arrows pan; Shift+arrows moves a page; Home/End visits corners; Enter returns to the grid.
maps.viewHelp: Zoom out to see more tiles or zoom in for detail. Turn on Pan map and drag to move the view, or drag with the middle mouse button in any tool. Pan buttons move one tile; Previous/Next moves one page. In Pan mode, arrow keys move the view. With grid focus, +/− zooms and 0 returns to 100%. Ctrl/Cmd+wheel zooms around the pointer. View changes do not edit the map.
maps.tilesetInUse: Remove or replace terrain image selections before removing this tileset.
maps.invalidTilesetId: Choose a unique tileset ID using letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
maps.tilesetHelp: Choose an image and its tile size, then click a tile below to assign it to the selected paint terrain. Transparent areas show the terrain's base color. Turn off Use base color for image-only tiles. Coordinates start at 1.
maps.importHelp: Import an image in Assets first, then add a tileset here. PNG and WebP support transparent overlays.
maps.fillLayerConfirm: Fill every cell in {layer} with {terrain}? Other layers stay unchanged.
maps.clearLayerConfirm: Clear all objects from layer {layer}? Ground and other layers stay unchanged.
maps.removeLayerConfirm: Remove layer {layer} and all its objects?
maps.invalidLayer: Choose a layer ID using letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
maps.layerLimit: A map supports up to 32 overlay layers.
maps.layerHelp: Ground is always at the bottom. Overlay layers draw in the listed order; Move layer up draws it above other objects. Empty cells show the layers below. Paint and Erase affect only the selected layer. Hidden layers are not drawn and do not affect movement; show a layer before painting. Turn off Layer affects movement for decorations. The player appears above all layers.
maps.copyReady: Copied {width} × {height}. Click a destination to paste; paste again to reuse it.
maps.moveReady: Move ready: {width} × {height}. Source tiles stay in place until you paste at a valid destination.
maps.selectionHelp: Choose Select tiles and drag a rectangle on the active layer. Shift-click or Shift+arrow keys extends it; Enter selects a tile. Ctrl/Cmd+C copies, X cuts, and V prepares paste while the grid has focus. Click or press Enter to paste at the top-left destination. Escape cancels a pending move or clears the selection. The clipboard stays within this map; saving commits your edits.
maps.invalidSelection: Select a valid rectangle within the active layer first.
maps.pasteOutsideMap: The entire copied group must fit inside the map. Choose another destination.
maps.clipboardTerrainMissing: A copied terrain type no longer exists. Copy the group again.
maps.cutSourceChanged: The cut source changed. Select and cut the group again before moving it.
maps.invalidGroundFill: Choose an existing replacement terrain for ground tiles. Ground cannot contain empty cells.
